notes: The photographs are original KYP schematic redraws (palm with the single transverse crease + arrow, scalp vertex cutis-aplasia patch, clenched fist with overlapping finger outlines) — diagnostic patterns preserved without reproducing the clinical images. The nondisjunction figure is an original KYP redraw preserving both columns' gamete census and all the source labels (Meiosis I/II, Nondisjunction, Gametes, Trisomy, Monosomy, Normal, n+1/n/n−1). The two screening tables are implemented as the note's table block with the source's exact marker directions.
